author: mark
text: Stack changed from Dioxus-desktop to egui/eframe. Reason: Dioxus-desktop requires libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev (and friends) on Linux — a heavy, version-specific system dep incompatible with the repo's 'no weird system libs' aesthetic. egui is winit-based; its system deps (X11/Wayland core) are universal on any Linux desktop. The pluggability contract (§3.5) is unchanged; a future browser-based 'lernie-ui-web' crate would share the pure-Rust view-model layer.

author: mark
text:
2026-04-26 (opus): Filed missing done-when scope as three new phase
children — bl-51d9 (Phase 7: streaming end-to-end), bl-0da0 (Phase 8:
state badges + pulse), bl-1b27 (Phase 9: user-action triggers). The
six already-archived phases delivered foundations (skeleton,
fs_watcher, cli_outbound, git_tree renderer for v0.1/v0.2/v0.3
shapes); the new phases close the gap between "data layer wired up"
and the done-when's full-UX criteria.

Resume button explicitly NOT scoped into v0.5: lernie resume <repo>
re-enters the workflow state machine per ARCH §1 / §6 / §603, and
the workflow state machine itself is v0.6 work. The v0.6 epic will
add the lernie resume subcommand and its UI button as one piece.
v0.5 done-when's "resume" criterion is therefore deferred to v0.6;
flag if this needs an epic-level done-when edit.

Gate sequencing: v0.5 terminal gates (bl-5fca/bl-686e/bl-a008)
should not be claimed until all three new phases land — same rule
that applied to bl-7c23's gates.
